New: deep clean! A third tab for the junk every phone collects.

- app caches: see how much each app is hiding, and clear them all through Android's own screen
- leftover cache folders and temp files apps leave in your storage
- gallery thumbnails
- empty folders left behind by apps you removed
- big files you haven't touched in 3 months
- apps you haven't opened in over a month, with an uninstall button

Nothing is deleted until you confirm, the safe stuff starts ticked and big files never do. It needs "all files access" and "usage access", which you switch on yourself from the tab.

Needs Android 11 or newer. Download octo-potato.apk below and open it on your phone.
